basic_details.job_title: ICAR IARI Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Division of Agricultural Economics, ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), New Delhi is filling one Young Professional-II (YP II) post on contract. The post is for the project "Economic survey on stakeholder/s preferences in target crops under ICAR-Network Project on Translational Genomics in Crop Plants (TGCP)". The engagement lasts up to 31 March 2027 and pays Rs. 42,000 a month, fixed, with no HRA. Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree (M. Sc.) in one of the subjects the notice lists, with thesis work. To apply, email the application form and documents to [email protected]

qualification.details: Post Graduate Degree (M. Sc.) in Agricultural Economics/ Dairy Economics/ Fisheries Economics/ Agricultural Statistics/ Economics (with thesis work). Only candidates who have the essential qualifications will be called for the online interview.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted in online mode only, by email to [email protected]. They must be sent by 23 November 2026.
Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of the notice) in the given format, typed or by hand.
Affix a recent self-attested passport-size photograph to the form, then scan the form.
Fill in and sign the declaration (Annexure-II) about relatives working at ICAR/IARI. Every candidate must send it, including those with no such relatives.
Scan self-attested copies of the documents listed below.
Email the scanned form, the declaration and all the documents to [email protected] by 23 November 2026.
Application form (Annexure-I) with a recent photograph affixed
Self-attested copies of all certificates and mark sheets from matriculation onwards
Proof of experience or experience certificate (the form asks only for experience of one year or more)
Proof of SC/ST/OBC status, if applicable
No Objection Certificate from the current employer, if employed
Publications (published research papers only, with proof)
Signed declaration (Annexure-II) about relatives working at ICAR/IARI

The application form also asks for your age on the date of interview, your correspondence and permanent addresses with PIN code, your mobile number and email address, your educational record from Class 10 onwards (with subjects and percentage of marks) and two references with their phone numbers and email addresses. It ends with a signed self-declaration that the details are true.
important_instructions: If you make a false claim and it is found later, your candidature will be summarily rejected. Hiding facts or canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification or termination. If any information in the application is found false, incorrect or incomplete, or you are found ineligible before or after the interview or selection, your candidature or appointment may be cancelled without notice. If the information in the relatives declaration is wrong or hides facts, your candidature for the interview or selection is liable to be cancelled.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-IARI
content_sections.text: The ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI) is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) in New Delhi. This post is in the Institute's Division of Agricultural Economics. The work is an economic survey of stakeholder preferences in target crops under the ICAR-Network Project on Translational Genomics in Crop Plants (TGCP).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Post Graduate Degree (M. Sc.) in Agricultural Economics/ Dairy Economics/ Fisheries Economics/ Agricultural Statistics/ Economics (with thesis work). Only candidates who have the essential qualifications will be called for the online interview. Experience in data collection and data analysis of primary and secondary data Handling of software like MS Excel, R and STATA Good scientific writing skills The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 45 years as on the date of interview (25 November 2026). If you are currently working, you need a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your present employer. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay: Rs. 42,000/- per month, fixed. No HRA is paid. The post is purely temporary and contractual. It is filled at first for up to 31 March 2027 or until the project is completed, whichever is earlier. The post ends with the project (co-terminus). The selected candidate cannot claim a regular appointment at the Institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IARI Young Professional -II (YP II)
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted in online mode only, by email to [email protected] . They must be sent by 23 November 2026. Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of the notice) in the given format, typed or by hand. Affix a recent self-attested passport-size photograph to the form, then scan the form. Fill in and sign the declaration (Annexure-II) about relatives working at ICAR/IARI. Every candidate must send it, including those with no such relatives. Scan self-attested copies of the documents listed below. Email the scanned form, the declaration and all the documents to [email protected] by 23 November 2026. Application form (Annexure-I) with a recent photograph affixed Self-attested copies of all certificates and mark sheets from matriculation onwards Date of birth certificate NET/equivalent certificate Proof of experience or experience certificate (the form asks only for experience of one year or more) Proof of SC/ST/OBC status, if applicable No Objection Certificate from the current employer, if employed Publications (published research papers only, with proof) Signed declaration (Annexure-II) about relatives working at ICAR/IARI The application form also asks for your age on the date of interview, your correspondence and permanent addresses with PIN code, your mobile number and email address, your educational record from Class 10 onwards (with subjects and percentage of marks) and two references with their phone numbers and email addresses. It ends with a signed self-declaration that the details are true.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through an online interview on 25 November 2026 from 10:00 AM. Only eligible candidates who have the essential qualifications will be called. Original documents will be checked at the final selection stage. The selected candidate must produce all original documents and medical certificates at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IARI Recruitment 2026 for YP II?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Young Professional -II (YP II) vacancy in the Division of Agricultural Economics, ICAR-IARI, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IARI YP II post?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed to [email protected] by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for IARI Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: You need a Post Graduate Degree (M. Sc.) in Agricultural Economics/ Dairy Economics/ Fisheries Economics/ Agricultural Statistics/ Economics (with thesis work). Experience in primary and secondary data collection and analysis, MS Excel, R and STATA, and good scientific writing skills are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IARI YP II post?
faq.answer: You must be at least 21 years old and no older than 45 years on the date of interview. SC/ST candidates and women get 5 years of relaxation, and OBC candidates get 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IARI Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 42,000/- per month, fixed.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 42,000 pay?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the pay of Rs. 42,000/- is fixed with no HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for IARI YP II 2026?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form (Annexure-I) with your photograph, the signed declaration (Annexure-II) and self-attested scanned copies of your certificates to [email protected] by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IARI YP II?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates who have the essential qualifications will be called for an online interview on 25 November 2026 from 10:00 AM. Original documents will be checked at the final selection.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IARI YP II post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and contractual, for up to 31 March 2027 or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. The selected candidate cannot claim a regular appointment at the Institute.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need an NOC to apply for IARI YP II?
faq.answer: Yes, if you are currently working. You must attach a No Objection Certificate from your current employer with the application.
